title: Early voting starts for NY and NJ on Saturday ahead of Election Day - ABC7 New York
text:
Early voting starts for NY and NJ on Saturday ahead of Election Day - ABC7 New York 
 24/7 Live New York City New Jersey Long Island Northern Suburbs Connecticut POLITICS 
 What to know about early voting in New York, New Jersey and Connecticut 
 Thursday, October 22, 2026 7:24PM 
 Stream New York's #1 news - AccuWeather - original content 24/7 NEW YORK (WABC) -- Early voting is already underway in Connecticut and opens in New York and New Jersey on Saturday.
 The early voting period runs through Nov. 1 in the Tri-State. Election Day is Tuesday, Nov. 3.
 NEW YORK
 There are several ways to vote in New York State , including in-person and early voting. Those voting by absentee ballot or by mail and overseas must follow specific deadlines for each election.
 You can find more details and apply for early voting by mail, absentee ballots, and military and overseas applications on the New York Board of Elections website .
 The early voting period in New York is October 24 through November 1. Hours vary by county.
 For more information visit the New York State Board of Elections .
 NEW JERSEY
 The early voting period is October 24 - November 1, 2026.
 October 27 - Deadline to apply for a mail-in ballot by mail for the General Election October 30 - Deadline for overseas civilian and military voters to apply for an electronic ballot November 2 - 3 PM - Deadline for in-person mail-in-ballot applications November 3 - 6 AM - 8 PM - General Election Day
 For more information about voting in New Jersey, please visit the NJ Voter Information Portal .
 CONNECTICUT
 If you are not registered but want to vote during the Early Voting period, you may register in person every day of Early Voting at the Early Voting location. The early voting period is October 19 - November 1, 2026.
 If you are not registered but want to vote on Election Day, you may register in person on Election Day (Nov. 3, 2026) at your Election Day Registration site.
 To receive important election updates, text VOTE to 860.321.4221. To find your Early Voting location and more information about elections in Connecticut, visit MyVote.CT.gov or call 860-509-6200.
